description: This research is part of the Strategic Project “Analysis of mobile applications from a data-protection perspective: Cyber-protection and cyber-risks for citizens’ information”, the result of a collaboration agreement between the Spanish National Cybersecurity Institute (INCIBE) —under the Ministry for Digital Transformation and Civil Service— and the National Distance-Learning University (UNED). The initiative is framed within the Recovery, Transformation and Resilience Plan and funded by the European Union’s Next-Generation funds.
